entities.summary: Delphine Horvilleur is France's third female rabbi, and editorial director of the quarterly Jewish magazine Tenou’a - Atelier de pensée(s) juive(s). She leads a congregation in Paris, and is currently co-leading the Liberal Jewish Movement of France, a Jewish liberal cultural and religious association affiliated to the World Union for Progressive Judaism, which she joined in 2008. She is also an author.
